title: Retrieval-first agent guidance: a retrieval topic, query-then-read in the overview, one generated skill, no retired Backlog/.codex preflight (OPAG-378)
description: Dispatched by opum-agent from its OPAG-378 primer audit (opum-agent origin/dev scratchpad/opag-378-primer-audit-2026-09-23.md, measured against lore 0.9.0). Operator ruling as relayed: lore-native retrieval fixes come before any external router. The audit measured lore query --limit 5 then lore read <id> answering 3/3 opum-doc questions in ~1.2s and 2-5k tokens, and found no primer or instruction that tells an agent to do so; lore instructions begins at docs/index.md. Defects: (1) instructions.ts overview loop is browse-first and there is no single-repo retrieval topic (lore instructions retrieval exits 3). (2) agent-bridge.ts nudge frames lore as authoring-only and hardcodes 5 of 7 topics; INSTRUCTION_DETAIL_TOPICS has the same problem. (3) skills/lore/SKILL.md says --max-tokens is advisory, which has been false since LCLI-478. (4) SKILL.md omits read, types and backlog, lists 5 of 7 topics, has no query-then-read recipe, and no lockstep test ties it to LORE_COMMANDS or the topics. (5) The repo-mode skill (buildSkillDoc) still carries the retired Backlog/.codex preflight. (6) Command summaries and lore help say commit backlog/ and backlog check. (7) The overview points at docs/runbooks/agent-onboarding.md, which resolves in 1 of 10 repos. skills/ changes what the next tag ships to opum-marketplace plugin users.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore instructions retrieval exits 0 and teaches query --limit then read (and context) for single-repo retrieval; the overview loop starts with retrieval, not docs/index.md
The CLAUDE.md nudge and the skill topic list are derived from the instructions topic list, so a new topic cannot be missed; the nudge names retrieval as well as authoring

skills/lore/SKILL.md is generated from the same builder as the repo-mode skill and a test fails when the committed file drifts from it; it lists every LORE_COMMANDS entry and every topic, gives the query-then-read recipe, and states --max-tokens as the hard ceiling it is
The generated skills carry no Backlog/.codex preflight; the self-commit sentence says link, unlink, rename and sync commit only on the Backlog backend, verified against the code
No command summary or lore help line says commit backlog/ or backlog check unless it is Backlog-specific
The overview no longer points at a file most repositories lack
lore instructions retrieval and the regenerated nudge are run against a built binary, not only unit-tested

implementationNotes: DESIGN MEASUREMENT for opum-agent (lore agent context fallback question; the decision is the orchestrator's, not decided here). 2026-09-24, opum-doc origin/dev b58accf snapshot, lore 0.9.1 built binary. Question set: every opum-doc tracker record whose documentation field names an existing non-index docs/*.md (69 of 247 records read); the named docs are the answers. Profile pack (implementation): answer selected 8/69; answer among the profile's candidates at all 8/69; 48,106B median (47,872-48,243); 0.69s median. Query --limit 5 then read top-1, question = record TITLE: answer #1 61/69, top-5 68/69; 5,125B median (max 28,238); 1.23s median. Title paraphrases the doc title, so a bias control used the description prose (frontmatter stripped, first 200 chars): #1 28/69, top-5 51/69. The first control run was invalid: descriptions carry Backlog frontmatter, and a query beginning with --- is parsed as an option (exit 2 on 66/69), so the text is passed after --. Miss detection: the pack's top in-profile BM25 score is 9.13-39.75 (median 30.46) on hits and 5.38-38.11 (median 12.43) on misses. The ranges overlap and no miss scores 0, so a score threshold cannot detect when the pack missed. Of the pack's 61 misses, query top-5 (title) recovers 60.

Implementation proof, 2026-09-24. Built dist/lore. lore instructions retrieval exits 0. In a fresh repo, lore agents writes a nudge whose topic list names all 8 topics and leads with the query-then-read line, and lore agents --check then exits 0. The new binary over bridges written by 0.9.0 exits 6: CLAUDE.md reports updated, and the repo-mode SKILL.md reports protected, so it needs --force (recorded in the CHANGELOG). Lockstep suite test/plugin-skill.test.ts, mutation-checked: hardcoding the old 5-topic list turns exactly the 5 predicted cases red (committed file, plugin/repo/codex topic lists, nudges), and the other 8 stay green. scripts/plugin-skill.ts --check exited 1 on the old committed file before --write. Two existing tests that required the retired preflight section were flipped deliberately (agents.test.ts, agent-profile.test.ts). Suite 3386 pass / 0 fail; lint and typecheck clean; lore check 0 errors. NOT DONE HERE: (a) this repo's own CLAUDE.md lore:agents block is now stale; regeneration is pending the carve-out ruling and it is a governing file; (b) docs/reference/operate-autonomous-lore-cli-documentation-campaigns.md still describes the backlog-handover preflight, a separate doc edit.

CORRECTION to my earlier proof note, after the adversarial review of #237. The mutation I reported (hardcode the old 5-topic list, 5 red) measured the wrong object. That list also lacked retrieval, so every red came from retrieval alone, and the topic test asserted a bare key that the command list also satisfies (sync/check/types/agents). Dropping types and agents alone passed 75/0. Fixed: the tests now assert within the rendered topic section (topicSectionOf). Re-measured with the defect's own shape: dropping types+agents from the skill topic rows turns exactly 2 predicted cases red (plugin and repo topic lists), and dropping agents from the inline key list turns exactly 2 red (codex skill and nudges). Also fixed from the review: biome.json now lints scripts/**/*.ts (it was typechecked but not linted, while the coverage comment claimed both); the dash-text guidance now puts flags before --; the lore graph reason is corrected; the overview test checks order; an agents.test slice could no longer fall back to the whole doc; the hermes and antigravity bridges say tracker, not Backlog; cli-surface.md lists retrieval. Doc drift is filed separately (agent-onboarding.md, operate-autonomous-campaigns.md). Gates: 3386 pass / 0 fail, lint and typecheck clean, lore check 0 errors.
finalSummary: Delivered in opum-ai/lore-cli#237 (OPAG-378). Agent guidance is now retrieval-first: a new lore instructions retrieval topic, and the overview plus every generated bridge lead with query --limit 5 then read. Topic lists are derived from DETAIL_TOPICS. skills/lore/SKILL.md is generated (scripts/plugin-skill.ts) and pinned by test/plugin-skill.test.ts, which asserts topic sections and is mutation-checked with the defect's own shape. The retired Backlog/.codex preflight is removed, and help summaries are tracker-neutral. Adversarially reviewed with nothing blocking; its findings were fixed in the same PR. Ships to plugin users at the next tag. Bridges written by older lore report drift until regenerated, and repo-mode SKILL.md needs --force. Not done here: this repo's own CLAUDE.md lore:agents block is stale pending the carve-out ruling; doc drift is LCLI-574. The measurement behind OPAG-378's design ruling (query-augmented packs) is in this record's notes.
